Kasboek — a private, local-first budget app with Claude built in. Your data stays on your computer, encrypted and locked to your computer and login.

## Download

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows (most PCs) | `Kasboek-…-win-x64.msi` or `Kasboek-…-win-x64.exe` |
| Windows on ARM (Snapdragon) | `Kasboek-…-win-arm64.msi` or `…-win-arm64.exe` |
| macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) | `Kasboek-…-mac.dmg` |
| Linux | `.AppImage` (any distribution) or `.deb` (Debian/Ubuntu), x64 or arm64 |

All builds are 64-bit. An export made on one system imports on any other with your login.

## First start

These builds are not yet signed with a certificate:
- **Windows** shows “Windows protected your PC”: click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **macOS** says it can’t verify the developer: **right-click Kasboek → Open**, once.

## Good to know

- First test release. Windows Hello and Touch ID were only tested in simulation; please report anything odd.
- To use Claude, add your own Anthropic API key in Settings → Claude.
